decisions.reason: Having remained on the market after its launch, this seamless-covering shower channel is a low-cost option close to our core range, so we keep it while demand in design-oriented bathrooms becomes clearer.
The tileable floor drain fits our established barrier-free drainage portfolio and capabilities very closely, so the prudent choice is to keep it as a solid option with limited downside.

This newer pump-drain shower channel is a more uncertain and support-intensive niche option, and the earlier withdrawal of a related pump product raises the exit risk, but we keep it for now to gather more evidence on its market value.
